OFFICE OF BARANGAY CAPTAIN

 CERTIFICATION

 

 

TO WHOM IT MAY CONCERN:

 

 This to certify that MR. DEN MARK B. ETORMA, 17 years old, a resident of Purok 2, Governor Boyles, Ubay, Bohol is a bonafide member and resident of this barangay.

 

This certifies that he/she has no derogatory record and has a good moral character as per our barangay record concerned.

 

 This CERTIFICATION is being issued upon the request of the above name mentioned in connection to his/her ENROLLMENT IN TAGBILARAN CITY COLLEGE (TCC) and for whatever purposes it may serve.

 

 Given this 23rd day of JULY, 2024, at Barangay Governor Boyles, Ubay, Bohol, Philippines
